messages:
maria: Heads up — embeddings KV-cache regression in eu-west1 showing 5-10% p99 latency increase after last quantization tweak. We rolled the change to staging, caught it in perf tests, and now seeing it in prod. Hotfix PR ready to revert the change: hotfix/revert-quant-eu1. Need expedited deploy in the next 10m. @release-manager can you sign off? :warning:

deploy-bot: New deploy request queued by maria: hotfix/revert-quant-eu1
  - plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%
  - smoke checks: embeddings smoke, token service sanity, svc-metrics up
  - rollback: automatic on error or manual /rollback hotfix/revert-quant-eu1
  (use `/deploy approve 6043210000` to approve)

aj: Ack. Two asks before approve: define quick rollback criteria and confirm no schema change. Also need a short release note.

sam: Verified PR — it's just a revert of the quant flag, no schema or model change. I ran a 500-sample embed smoke in staging: p50=22ms p99=160ms (was 180-220 on prod right now).

lee: oncall-ops here. I can monitor eu-west1 metrics and be ready to cut traffic if errors spike. +1 if smoke passes and release-manager signs.

release-manager: Quick release note: "Revert recent quantization flag change affecting KV-cache path in EU embeddings. Restores previous latency profile; no model weights changed." Approving for expedited hotfix. +1 from me.

maria: Adding rollback criteria: if 5xx rate > 0.5% OR p99 latency increases by >20% vs baseline for 5m, rollback and alert. Also will watch error budget burn.

oncall-ops: Confirmed metric watches and runbook ready: `eu1-embed-p99`, `eu1-embed-5xx`. If triggered, I'll run `kubectl rollout undo deploy/embed-service -n prod --to-revision=RELEASE_BEFORE_HOTFIX` and open incident.

deply-bot: (note: small typo)

deploy-bot: Approval received from release-manager, approvals: release-manager, sam (code owner). Waiting for explicit /deploy approve from two engineers to start.

aj: /deploy approve 6043210000 — I approve the expedite and smoke criteria.

maria: /deploy approve 6043210000 — starting canary now.

deploy-bot: Deployment started: hotfix/revert-quant-eu1
  - step: canary (5% traffic)
  - command: `kubectl set image deploy/embed-service embed=embed:v2-revert-quant --namespace=prod-eu1`
  - monitoring hooks: smoke-run and metric-check

lee: Canary smoke passed — embeddings p99 155ms, no 5xx. Shifting to 25%.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift: canary -> 25% (in progress)

deploy-bot: Canary healthy after 25% for 3m, no errors, p99 stable. Proceeding to 100% roll.

maria: Rolling to 100% now. Thanks for the quick approvals everyone.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: hotfix/revert-quant-eu1 -> 100% traffic. All smoke checks green.

oncall-ops: Monitoring: metrics look good at 15m post-deploy, p99 back to baseline, error budget stable. Closing expedited window.

release-manager: Please add the hotfix note to changelog and send short blurb to #customer-notices if needed (low severity).

sam: Added to changelog: "hotfix: revert quant flag — restores embeddings latency in EU".

maria: Great work. Follow-up: we'll schedule a deeper perf postmortem to understand why the staging signal didn't fully match prod.

lee: +1 on postmortem. I'll keep an eye on eu-west1 for the next 2 hours. :white_check_mark:
